'''Bo''' (Po, Sorimi) is a possible [[Left May languages|Left May]] language of [[New Guinea]], in Sandaun and East Sepik Provinces. It is essentially undocumented, and its status as a separate language is unconfirmed.<ref name=e25/> It is spoken in Bo, Kaumifi, Kobaru, and Nigyama Umarita villages in [[Sandaun Province]].<ref name=e25/><ref name="UN-PNG">{{cite web |url=https://data.humdata.org/dataset/village-coordinates-lookup |title=Papua New Guinea Village Coordinates Lookup |author=United Nations in Papua New Guinea |work=Humanitarian Data Exchange |version=1.31.9 |date=2018}}</ref>
